notes: Open or removed states are treated as on; closed or attached states are treated as off. Closely spaced manipulations of the paired cabinet doors are reported separately because each door is a distinct movable part. The two separate approach/open/close cycles at the cupboard right of the range are also retained as distinct episodes.
scene_description: A user moves through a kitchen and sequentially manipulates the refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper-cabinet doors, followed by lids on two countertop cookers and the drawer of an air fryer.
